components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold CTA button. Pill shape, dark text on gold background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 36px; background: #D4A843; color: #0B0E14; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92em; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(212,168,67,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E8C456; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 32px rgba(212,168,67,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary transparent button with subtle border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 28px; background: transparent; color: #A09888; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.88em; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border-color: #D4A843; color: #E8C456; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Pill-shaped nav link inside the glass top bar. Active state highlights in gold.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; color: #A09888; font-size: 0.82em; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: transparent; border: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #E8E2D9; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-nav-active { color: #E8C456; background: rgba(212,168,67,0.08); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Parchment Card
components.description: Warm parchment card with star corner decorations. The primary content surface.
components.html:
FEATURED

Card Title

Body text on warm parchment — readable and inviting against the dark astral backdrop.
components.css: .ds-card-parchment { position: relative; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(212,168,67,0.06) 0%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(160deg, #F2E8D5 0%, #EDE0C8 40%, #E8DCC8 100%); border: 1px solid #C4B08A; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); padding: 32px; color: #2D2418; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-parchment:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 30px rgba(212,168,67,0.25); } .ds-card-label { font-family: Cinzel,'PingFang SC',serif; font-size: 0.7em; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #B8943A; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-heading { font-family: Cinzel,'PingFang SC',serif; font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: 700; color: #2D2418; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 0.88em; color: #5C4E3A; line-height: 1.8; }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Dark astral card for secondary content. Purple accent label.
components.html:
CONTACT

Card Title

Secondary content on the dark astral surface.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background: #181E38; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-dark:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-card-label-dark { font-family: Cinzel,'PingFang SC',serif; font-size: 0.7em; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #9075D9; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-heading-dark { font-family: Cinzel,'PingFang SC',serif; font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: 700; color: #E8E2D9; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-text-dark { font-size: 0.88em; color: #A09888; line-height: 1.8; }

components.name: Glass Navigation
components.description: Fixed top nav: transparent at top, frosted glass on scroll.
components.html: ✦ Brand
components.css: .ds-topnav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 64px; z-index: 1000; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 32px; background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: background 0.5s, border-color 0.5s; } .ds-topnav.scrolled { background: rgba(17,22,42,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); box-shadow: 0 1px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: Cinzel,'PingFang SC',serif; font-size: 1.05em; font-weight: 700; color: #E8E2D9; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-brand:hover { color: #D4A843; }

narrative.overview: 这是一个悬浮在星云深处的魔法图书馆。访客穿越黑暗虚空，推开玻璃门，眼前是漂浮在星辉中的羊皮纸卷轴——金色的星芒标记着每一段重要的记忆。东西不多但每件都用心，光线来自星体本身，暗而不冷。核心张力：暗色星界的宏大感 vs 羊皮纸卡片的亲切感。Cinzel 拉丁标题营造史诗氛围，中文系统字体保持阅读舒适。金色是唯一的亮色——出现在星芒装饰、按钮、激活态——恰如星空中最亮的那颗。
keyCharacteristics: 星界暗底（#0B0E14）为唯一页面基调
暖羊皮纸卡片（#F2E8D5）承载所有正文内容
SVG Mask 星芒伪元素装饰卡片四角
12 列 Bento Grid 承载内容分区
Cinzel Display 仅用于英文标题/眉题

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: 星芒金覆盖不超过任何一屏 5% 的面积。

rules.name: The Parchment Island Rule
rules.body: 羊皮纸色只在卡片容器内出现。背景永远是暗色星界系。

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Cinzel 仅用于英文。中文使用系统字体继承。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 卡片静止时投影仅用一层。金色外发光只在 hover 态叠加。

dos: Do 用星芒金作为唯一 accent——仅在按钮、星芒角、导航激活态出现
Do 保持暗色星界基底贯穿全页
Do 给每张卡片明确的 hover 反馈——上浮 4px + 金辉外发光
Do 对羊皮纸卡片使用星芒角装饰
donts: Don't 在羊皮纸卡片以外的区域使用暖色调背景
Don't 引入第二个饱和 accent 色与金色平起平坐
Don't 在导航栏之外使用毛玻璃
Don't 使用企业官网式商务冷淡排版
Don't 套用千篇一律 SaaS 落地页模板
Don't 使用 AI 默认紫/蓝渐变
Don't 堆叠卡片（card inside card）
